lines: Kaura slashed at Sakura with her soul-stealing demonic sword.
It was fierce swordsmanship characteristic of a self-taught style, which seemed to suddenly launch straight into a finishing blow, without either taking a combat stance or feinting.
Despite letting out a surprised remark, Sakura dodged into a shadow a split second sooner, and
Letting out a relaxed voice, she dealt Kaura a counterattack from a complete blind spot.
Although she had avoided a fatal blow through her primal instincts, Kaura's side had been slashed open deeply.
「Oh, you dodged that. That's the warden of Amidahara Prison for you. You're not too bad!」
「Kuh...... Shit?!!! You're strong, aren'tcha, for havin' that silly face?!」
「Don't underestimate me. A wound this slight is nothing to me!」
She lifted up her sword with a look of rage, and the wound she had sustained was regenerated using all of the prisoners' souls that she had absorbed with it up to now.
「Hoho! You can even heal your wounds by yourself. But it's not quite good enough, you know?」
「Your regeneration's a little slow. My best friend Mucchan recovers as soon as you cut her.」
「Even when she has her head chopped off every once in a while, it's stuck back on before the blade comes out of her neck. Compared to that, you've got a long way to go.」
「Don't screw with me! There's no way someone like that exists!」
「There is, though. I mean, check this out―――」
Sakura's figure disappeared into a shadow.
Kaura narrowly dodged this time as well, but her wound, which had not yet finished healing, was gouged into even more deeply.
The prisoners' souls tried to repair that wound, but before that could happen, the next blade slashed open a different spot.
Sakura attacked Kaura incessantly, repeatedly appearing and disappearing into shadows.
「Guh, gah...... D-Dammit...... Moving around all over the place!!!」
Kaura swung her demonic sword around like crazy as her entire body became covered in blood.
Due to the ferocity and erraticism of that, even Sakura couldn't deliver a finishing blow easily, but nevertheless, the injuries were coming faster than her recovery.
「See? Your regeneration isn't gonna make it in time.」
「I've told Fuuma-kun this too, but you're better off not relying on that ability too much unless something drastic happens.」
「Like I know who that is!! Who the hell are you?!」
「Right now, I'm the prince, I guess.」
Even Kaura, who had displayed unrivalled strength in the battle with the armed refugees, could do nothing when faced with the little sister of the Almighty Taimanin.
「Mmmm, stubborn, huh? But you're at your limit now, aren't you?」
「Heh...... I wonder about that? Don't underestimate me...... too much!」
「I'm not underestimating you. Oh well, shall I finish this with the next one, then?」
Sakura launched into her deadly “Shadow Swordfight” move.
It was a technique wherein she thrust dozens of blades out of the shadows, skewering an enemy from all directions in an instant.
It was rumoured that, if delivered with precision, it would even thwart the Immortal Awakening of her best friend, Yatsu Murasaki. She would probably never do that, though.
However, due to its enormous power, mental concentration was required to execute the technique.
Kaura faintly laughed. She had been waiting for that.
She had recognized the overwhelming difference in strength from her first brush with the enemy, and had been pretending to attack recklessly to buy time.
Sakura reflexively tried to dodge into a shadow, due to a surprise attack by a third party.
However, she was too late to realize.
The chains of Tekkain Kaworu, the ruler of Amidahara Prison, had wrapped around Sakura's body and captured her.
「Hey, what're these chains?! They won't come loose?? No waaay! I can't slip into a shadow either! Seriously?」
「Fufu, it's no use. Those chains get sturdier and heavier depending on the weight of the sins of the person they've captured.」
「There's no human being who's never committed a sin in their life. Being alive means taking other lives and using them for sustenance, after all.」
「That kind of trick, huh? I give up. You caught me. So, are you the boss of this place?」
「Tekkain Kaworu. It's a typically underhanded way of doing things for the Taimanin, to try and make Kaura your inside man.」
「Dang it. That got out too, huh?」
「It looks like ultimately, your aim was Yuffie and Sophie, yes?」
「Well, that's about the shape of it. Hahaha...」
「But that's too bad. They're valuable commodities that are in my charge, so I couldn't possibly hand them over.」
「Onee-chan was no use at all, was she?」
「I wonder if, actually, it's because she doesn't have a prince of her own?」
「You're right. It's 'cause she doesn't have a prince of her own, isn't it?」
「Hey! Don't hammer it home! Onee-chan just let her guard down a little!」
「Letting your guard down is a no-no!」
「You shouldn't be letting your guard down, right?」
「Tch...... What's with this lady? She's been captured, but she's not bothered at all.」
Kaura said in apparent irritation, having regenerated all of the wounds she had received from Sakura.
「That's how much experience you have, is it? Or might you still be hiding some tricks?」
Regardless of her inner thoughts, no unrest could be seen in Sakura's appearance.
「Shit. So, Boss, whadda we do with this woman?」
「Interrogate her. To all appearances, she seems to be a VIP from Gosha, after all.」
「That girl looks like she could make me some money...」
While muttering that to herself, she left the underground cell behind.
It seemed that she was scheming to capture Kirara (Fuuma) and make money whoring her out.
